chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: Recruiting Rene Hall and the Biloxi Golden Gloves story
summary: West brings Rene Hall from New Orleans; his mother consents after Rene's close call with a white mob at a Golden Gloves bout.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Anyway, Spurgeon goes to Xavier and he came back one summer--it was the latter

So I said all right, and West goes back again. So I said, try when you come back this time to get Rene to come. So his mother--Rene got it in his head to come, and his mother called Spurgeon in; what kind of fellow is this Ernie Fields, and this and that, because Rene has just about made up his mind that he's going to go when you leave, he's going to go on back to Tulsa with you to join this band. So Spurgeon said he's a fine fellow and nice and clean cut and whatever he says he's going to get, he's going to get. Spurgeon said I wouldn't be going back to play with him if he wasn't, and everything is fine. So she said, I tell you what, I'm going to consent for him to
go because I'm afraid for him, he's about ready to kill somebody.

Rene was in a little Golden Glove and he went to Biloxi--Spurgeon said his mother told him--and the blacks won and so, the man-- the promoter, they were going to jump on the colored boys and beat them up because they had won and he gets an iceman to slip him into the ice truck, covered up like it was an ice wagon and get the guys back and he had to come back later, somebody to get the cars.

So when he got home, his mother-- he goes downtown and he went downtown and bought him a pistol, so he came back home and his mother said, Rene, what in the world are you doing with that? Mama, I ain't running no more. If this happens again, I'm going to get me one

of them to kill; and she said, what is it and he told her what happened, we won and they were just going to jump on us and beat us up if it hadn't of been for the promoter that slipped us into that ice truck, no telling what would have happened to us. And she said, well, what you can do is you just don't go anymore. Well, that's all right but if the other boys go I'm going too, I'm just going to be ready for them. And she said no, if it got like that, you just got to give it up. So she called up the guy up that had the youngsters and told him that she wasn't going to let Rene go out of town no more, that he could work around there but he wasn't going to go out of town.
So when that came up, she said I think I'll let Rene to go with you and so then Rene did come on to Tulsa then.
